description: getSeriesInfoFromCubePidCoord for a coordinate that doesn't exist (geography member 99 isn't a real member of table 14100287's Geography dimension). SUCCESS, HTTP 200, responseStatusCode 2, vectorId 0, and every field null - including the title. Contrast with census_series_info.json, which also has vectorId: 0 but a real title: the title is what tells these two apart, not the vector ID.
